name: the-farm
description: The farm release end to end: soil under the crops, an armful cap on the player, a push-scythe cutting three tiles in one swing, a crate bought and packed, a hand cart hitched and dragged and parked, a bag of goods left to spoil into Compost, and that Compost composted into Fertilizer and worked back into the ground. Pins the whole spoilage loop — nothing in it ends at zero value — and the assisted tier that softens it.
